Запрос — толстая оранжевая стрелка на пл: The query is the thick orange arrow on the key plane. Each object gets a score q·k, the dot product of the query and its key. Softmax turns the scores into weights that sum to 1. Rotate and stretch the query so that the cup gets more than half of the attention.
Скалярное произведение больше, когда стр: The dot product is larger when the arrows point the same way. Point the query along the cup's key and make it longer.
The cup got more than half of the attention. Its weight depends on all the keys at once: softmax normalizes the whole row, and the neighboring keys, the kettle's and the bowl's, take part of the weight. The query length works like sharpness: the longer the arrow, the bigger the difference between the scores and the sharper the peak.
An object's value is its location on the table. The attention output is a weighted sum of values, so the output is a point on the table, shown by the crosshair. Find a query for which the output lands on an empty spot: more than 15 cm from any object.

Если запрос совсем короткий, веса почти: If the query is very short, the weights are almost equal and the output lands at the middle of the table, where the sugar bowl stands. Turn the query between the keys of two objects that stand far apart on the table.
Ответ лёг на пустое место стола. Выход в: The output landed on an empty spot of the table. The attention output is a weighted sum of values. When the weights are spread out, the output ends up between the objects, where there's nothing. It's the same averaging as with regression in lesson 1.3: the average of two correct answers can itself be wrong.

До первого шага flow проходит 46 мс из 7: Before the first flow step, 46 ms of the 73 go by: the image encoders (14 ms) and the pass over the observation (32 ms). Then 10 flow steps of 51 tokens each read the ready K and V of the prefix and take 27 ms for all steps. Without the cache, every step would run the 816 observation tokens again: by our estimate 361 ms, five times longer. A new chunk starts every 25 ticks, that is, once every 0.5 s, while the robot gets an action every 20 ms. So the control rate, 50 Hz, is not the same as the inference rate: the model is called twice a second.

К двум видимым компонентам ключей и запр: Let's add hidden components to the two visible components of the keys and the query: random numbers with variance 1. The total number of components is set by d_k: in the 2017 transformer d_k = 64, in the language model inside π0 it's 256. The query is fixed in this mission. The experiment has two steps. Переключи столбики на q·k: без деления о: Switch the bars to q·k: without division the scores grew tens of times. Dividing by √d_k = 16 brings them back to single units.
The largest weight is ${fmt2(r.max)}. With independent components of variance 1, the variance of q·k equals d_k: at d_k = 256 the scores spread by about ±16, and softmax of such numbers almost always gives a single peak. Dividing by √256 = 16 brings the spread back to one.Why a single peak is bad for training. The network learns by adjusting queries and keys: it looks at how the output would change if a score moved a little, and that is the gradient. When all the weight is on one object, moving another object's score barely changes its weight. The gradient is near zero, and the network can't learn to look at another object, even when it needs to. In the diagram the cup's score moves by ±1.5 with the same scores as in the experiment.Our hidden components are random, so after division the weights barely depend on the query. In a trained model all 256 components carry meaning, and the division keeps the scores in a working range.
До сих пор работала одна <b>голова</b> в: So far a single attention head has been at work: one query, one set of keys, one set of weights. A transformer layer has several heads. Each one is a separate attention with its own matrices for the query, keys and values, so each compares tokens by its own features. The heads run at the same time on the same tokens, and their outputs are then concatenated.Here there are two heads. The “color” head sees only color, the “location” head only where an object stands. The cup is red and stands at the front edge. But in the “color” head its key coincides with the kettle's, and in the “location” head with the bowl's. Tune both heads so that the cup comes out on top in both. You switch heads above the key plane.
Все настройки сразу: запросы обеих голов: All the settings at once: the queries of both heads, d_k with division and the π0 mask. Now you can drag the keys too. Try pulling apart the coinciding keys of the cup and the kettle and watch the “color” head start telling them apart.

Клетка на пересечении строки i и столбца: The cell at row i and column j is the similarity of the encodings of positions i and j, like in the diagram above, but for all pairs of positions 0–23. The diagonal and the cells next to it are the brightest: neighboring positions are similar and distant ones less so, which is why the same word in different places gets different vectors. The frame marks positions 0–3, where the command sits. Hover over a cell.
<b>0 мс</b> — кадры пришли с камер, начи: 0 ms: the frames have arrived from the cameras, and the image encoders start.
Сделай ставку про кэш, потом найди два м: Make a bet about the cache, then find two moments. On the inference bar, click the blocks: the cursor goes to the start of a block, and the time appears under the bar. On the control tape, click the ticks.
Найдено, когда начинается первый шаг flo: Found when the first flow step starts: click the “10 flow steps” block
Нажми на оранжевый блок «10 шагов flow»:: Click the orange “10 flow steps” block: the cursor goes to its start, and under the bar you see how many milliseconds have passed before it. On the tape, look for the tick where the chunk color changes.
Действие — 8 целых чисел. Модель выписыв: An action is 8 integers. The model writes them out the same way as the text of an answer.
Каждое из 7 чисел действия заменяет редк: Each of the 7 action numbers replaces a rare word in the language model's vocabulary.
Пачку сжимают в 30–60 токенов, и модель: The chunk is compressed into 30–60 tokens, and the model writes them out one by one.
Декодер получает 100 пустых запросов и з: The decoder gets 100 empty queries and fills in all 100 actions in one pass.
Голова на выходе 20 раз убирает шум из ч: The output head removes noise from the draft chunk 20 times.
10 раз уточняет черновик из 50 действий,: Refines a draft of 50 actions 10 times, starting from noise.
За 4 шага flow matching превращает шум в: Turns noise into 16 actions in 4 flow matching steps.
